source_version: Theory of Computing15(2019),Article2; final publisher source September7,2019
title: Tight expected-amortized cell-probe lower bound for online convolution

standard_prerequisites.name: Entropy, randomized cell-probe model and elementary matrix algebra
standard_prerequisites.statement: Original model and cited generic encoding bound retained; all source-local Toeplitz, fixed-array and charging arguments retained.
standard_prerequisites.use: No collector reproof, no worst-case strengthening.

core_obligations: The authors extract stream-block entropy through Toeplitz convolution submatrices and construct a fixed array with power-of-two positions that recovers many unknown symbols at every information-transfer scale. Complete local hard-array construction, entropy accounting and tree charging are retained. This linear inner-product mechanism differs from the Hamming hard-string/vector-code construction.
